summary: Carbon County steel lookout built 1922 by the Anthracite Forest Protective Association, 42 or 50 ft by source; removed 1929; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says it was removed in 1929; no source describes what remains at the site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A Wilkes-Barre Record item of April 1922 gives the tower as fifty feet (about 15.2 m); a Forest Leaves note of 1922 gives 42 feet (12.8 m). The record keeps 12.8 m from the Forest Leaves figure. The sources do not explain the difference, and the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two sources. The register gives the 1922 build by AFPA and the 1929 removal; only the register gives the 1929 date, and the Forest Lookouts page does not mention removal. The brief carries coordinates (40.8556, -75.7458) that no source read gives; the register says 'No coordinates are available', so check before using the map pin. The brief's agency and 42-foot height are kept. The 'Flag Staff Park' landmark comes from the Forest Leaves note only. A different tower in the same area, the Mauch Chunk Fire Tower on Bear Mountain (built by CCC crews in 1936 per its NHLR record), is a separate register entry and was not used. No photos with URLs and licences were found. No staffing or fire history in any source read; topic left out.
